points.original_limitation: crules has automatic CopyLocalIUH/CopyLocalFPH and static LocalIUH/LocalFPH. Word ENTER_SECTION saves the dword parent. Calling L26_1if_d recursively enters crules at an internal label without ENTER_SECTION; its automatic saved pointers are zero. LEAVE_SECTION frees word locals and restores zero, so the dword continuation loses its parent allocation.
points.exact_diff_evidence: Top-level word cases pass; nested dword odd address1 raises C0000005 for each plane-pair base when only original lines827-828 are restored. Current local goto preserves the original word activation and all32 cases pass. SEH prevents a dialog; after exception remaining addresses in that lane are not run and are not counted passed.
points.minimum_option: Local goto to existing cleanup label; no second cleanup/state. Retained blank preserves original subsequent physical line numbers. A #line replacement would use the same number of differing lines, not reduce the diff.
points.line_error_check: Same physical line count; no #error directives changed; original anchors preserved.
